2.text: “Numvise byinshi nk'ibyoMwese ko muri abahumuriza baruhanya.

3.text: Mbese amagambo y'ubusa ntabwo azashira?Ikigutera kunsubiza ni iki?

4.text: Nanjye nashobora kuvuga nkamwe,Iyaba ari mwe mwari mumeze nkanjye,Nabashije gukoranya amagambo yo kubanegura,Nkabazunguriza umutwe.

5.text: Ahubwo nabakomeresha akanwa kanjye,No guhumuriza k'ururimi rwanjye kwaborohereza.

6.text: Nubwo mvuga umubabaro wanjye ntugabanuka,Naho nakwiyumanganya nakoroherwa nte?

8.text: Nanjye yankozeho ni byo bimpamya,Kunanuka kwanjye byarampagurukiye bimbera umushinja.

9.text: Yantanyaguje uburakari bwayo indenganya,Yampekenyeye amenyo,Umwanzi wanjye ankanuriye amaso.

10.text: Baranyasamiye,Bankubise ku itama barantukaBateraniye hamwe ngo bantere.

11.text: Imana yangabije abatayubaha,Injugunya mu maboko y'inkozi z'ibibi.

12.text: Nari nguwe neza maze iramvunagura,Ni ukuri yamfashe mu ijosi iramenagura,Kandi ingira intego yayo.

13.text: Abarashi bayo barangose,Impinguranije impyiko ntiyababarira,Isesa indurwe yanjye hasi.

15.text: “Umubiri wanjye nawudodeyeho ibigunira,Kandi ihembe ryanjye naritabye mu mukungugu.

16.text: Mu maso hanjye hakobowe no kurira,Amaso yanjye ararerembura nk'uwenda gupfa,

17.text: Nubwo ari nta rugomo ruri mu maboko yanjye,Kandi gusenga kwanjye kukaba gutunganye.

18.text: “Wa si we, we gutwikira amaraso yanjye,Kandi gutaka kwanjye kwe kugira aho guturiza.

19.text: N'ubu dore Imbera umuhamya iri mu ijuru,Indengera iri hejuru.

20.text: Incuti zanjye zirankoba,Ariko ijisho ryanjye rirasuka amarira imbere y'Imana,

21.text: Kugira ngo ihagarikire umuntu uyiburanya,N'umwana w'umuntu uburana na mugenzi we.

22.text: Kuko imyaka mike nishira,Nzanyura mu nzira ntazagarukamo ukundi.
